title: WU JEN FOURTH LEVEL SPELLS - the 24 fourth level wu jen spells with the school, component, casting time, saving throw, reversible and element codes
audit_label: R673 OA wu jen fourth level spells audit
audit_comment: OA round sixty (capture pp. 181-188): the wu jen fourth level spell stat blocks - the school, component, casting time and saving throw codes with the reversible and element markers, cross-checked spell by spell between the passes

banner.title: WU JEN FOURTH LEVEL SPELLS, printed capture pp. 181-188 - the OA wu jen fourth level spells round
banner.provenance: pinned from the 2018 print capture (the settling authority), with the compressed-print capture giving a second independent read (print pp. 181-188; compressed pp. 85-88); all 24 stat blocks cross-checked spell by spell between the passes, zero contested stat reads - the variances typographic or prose-only (the compressed minus signs for the spectral force plus signs, the degree marks for the inch marks). Alteration and enchantment/charm tie as the most common schools at six spells each, evocation four, abjuration three, invocation and illusion two each - THE INVOCATION SCHOOL DEBUTING for the wu jen (dream vision, vengeance); wall of bones the lone conjuration, its dual school Conjuration/Necromantic pinned primary 4 (the exaction precedent); no divination spell this level. The component census: 13 VSM, seven verbal and somatic, THREE verbal-only spells (dimension door, polymorph self, vengeance), shout the lone V,M. The casting times: seven four-segment (the most common cast), seven one-round, three one-turn (dream vision, minor creation, reverse flow), four three-segment, dimension door and shout the single segments, elemental turning the lone five-segment. Eight negation saves, three special, NO half save - the first wu jen level without one. Three spells read Reversible (dream vision, remove curse, reverse flow). The sixth column cross-checks the R669 element grid: the seven tagged cells matching the landed dieWJT66L4Element pins exactly - dimension door Earth, elemental turning All, fire enchantment, melt metal and wall of fire Fire, plant growth and polymorph other Nature. The stat grid pins as a table: 24 rows the spell ordinals, six columns - school, components (a V=1 S=2 M=4 bitmask), casting time in segments (1 round = 10, 1 turn = 60), saving throw code (0 none, 1 neg., 2 special, 3 half), reversible and element markers. The spell names ride the column comments, the prose descriptions close in their own rounds. The table tag WJL4Data identifier-safe per the R639 lesson
